tasks.build: deno bundle --platform browser --sourcemap linked -o web/dist/main.js web/main.ts && deno bundle --platform browser --sourcemap linked -o web/dist/play.js web/play.ts
tasks.watch: deno bundle --platform browser --sourcemap linked --watch -o web/dist/main.js web/main.ts
tasks.compile: deno task build && deno compile --unstable-net --allow-read --allow-net --allow-env --allow-run --allow-write=captures.log --include web/ --output dist/acweb src/tools/launcher.ts
tasks.release: deno task build && for t in aarch64-apple-darwin x86_64-apple-darwin x86_64-pc-windows-msvc x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; do deno compile --unstable-net --allow-read --allow-net --allow-env --allow-run --allow-write=captures.log --include web/ --target $t --output dist/acweb-$t src/tools/launcher.ts || exit 1; done
